findings.passage: This session, I filed several election integrity bills, including SB 2753, which treats early voting and Election Day voting as one continuous period, removing the gap between the two.
findings.note: His own newsletter describes his 2025 election bills. It says the continuous voting period change does not affect mail-in voting timelines. Does not mention ID or citizenship proof.

findings.passage: During the recent Regular Legislative Session, I authored Senate Bill 2753, which achieved some major wins for the integrity and security of our elections.
findings.note: His own newsletter describes SB 2753 (early voting and Election Day merged, tally tapes, single machine set) as an election security measure. Date taken from the newsletter file name.

Author of SB 1076, relating to permitted forms of identification for the purpose of accepting a voter. Referred to Senate State Affairs 2025-02-24 (date shown is the referral); no later action listed.
Author of SB 1473, relating to early voting by mail on the ground of absence from the voter's county of residence. Referred to Senate State Affairs 2025-03-06 (date shown is the referral).

Author of SB 2753, integrating early voting by personal appearance with Election Day voting and related changes to how returns are processed. Listed as effective 9/1/25 (date shown is the listed action 06/22/2025).
